subject.title: Feature Request: Auto-update deliveryContext based on message source channel

question: Should a WebChat message be allowed to permanently repoint an established external session delivery route, despite the route-preservation behavior that protects later asynchronous replies?
rationale: The requested behavior is the inverse of a deliberate current routing safeguard, and choosing its scope, persistence, and precedence cannot be resolved safely as a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep stable external routes
options.body: Retain the current behavior and document that WebChat can access a session without changing the external destination for later asynchronous delivery.

options.title: Add an explicit route policy
options.body: Adopt one narrowly named policy that deliberately switches the persisted route and specifies its interaction with WebChat, resets, subagents, and inter-session messages.

options.title: Use turn-local WebChat delivery
options.body: Keep the persisted external route while making only the immediate WebChat-originated response visible in the active WebChat surface.

recommendation.title: Keep stable external routes
recommendation.body: Retain the current behavior and document that WebChat can access a session without changing the external destination for later asynchronous delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The historical route-preservation change is the closest concrete ownership signal for deciding whether to reverse or extend this invariant.
